name: The First Oath
disclaimer: An original fictional story set in a region inspired by Maval, circa 1646.

stages.title: A village awakens
stages.detail: Speak with Keshav, the village elder.

stages.title: Carry what matters
stages.detail: Collect the village grain and bandages for the wounded at the fort.

stages.title: The mountain road
stages.detail: Mount Badal and follow the ridge to the lookout.

stages.title: Above the valley
stages.detail: Ride to the saffron flag at the lookout.

stages.title: Watch before you move
stages.detail: Dismount and observe the guarded route from the lookout.

stages.title: Leave no trace
stages.detail: Crouch past the patrol. Reach the northern ridge unseen.

stages.title: The stone threshold
stages.detail: Speak with Jiva at the fort entrance.

stages.title: The first oath
stages.detail: Deliver the supplies to Suryaji and learn what happened to Keshav’s son.

stages.title: A beginning, not an ending
stages.detail: First Oath complete. Next: scout the western water route. Explore freely.
